elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.intro
elements.html:
Evaluate a project against criteria, revise it, and defend a final use decision.

Check the project you actually made, not the one you hoped to make. Test a factual detail, a likely misunderstanding and an access need. Record a failure or limitation, make a revision, and retest. Your final decision may be use, revise further, or do not use. Explain why. A responsible conclusion can disagree with a tool, and a well-supported decision not to deploy can be stronger than a polished but unreliable result.

Practice scenario

Use your Lesson 14 artifact. If unavailable, use this fallback: “Book swap Thursday at 15:30, room 4, free pizza.” Source card: Tuesday, 15:30–16:00, library, free entry; no food promised.

choices.text: Ask only whether it looks impressive.
Compare every claim with the source and ask whether the text alone communicates the event.
Ask the same generator to guarantee perfection.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.test.feedback.likes
elements.html: Appearance does not check factual accuracy or access.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.test.feedback.criteria
elements.html: This checks facts and a defined access need.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.test.feedback.model
elements.html: A guarantee is not independent evidence.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.decision
elements.title: The draft still contains an unsupported promise. What is defensible?

choices.text: Remove it and retest, or withhold the draft until it can be checked.
Publish because most details are right.
Delete the limitation from the project card.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.decision.feedback.stop
elements.html: Both revision and non-use can be justified.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.decision.feedback.ship
elements.html: The remaining error can still mislead people.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.decision.feedback.hide
elements.html: That conceals rather than resolves the issue.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.before
elements.title: Paste the draft you are testing, or the complete fallback notice.

validators.text: Add at least 40 characters of work to submit.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.tests
elements.title: Record three actual checks and their results: factual accuracy, likely misunderstanding, and access without an image. Self-tests are valid; do not invent feedback.

validators.text: Add at least 80 characters of work to submit.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.after
elements.title: Paste the revised artifact and identify the change made because of a test.

validators.text: Add at least 60 characters of work to submit.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.transfer
elements.title: Submit a before/after pair, three test results, one remaining limitation, and a final use/revise/do-not-use decision. Explain what you can now do independently.
elements.description: Practice text only. Saved on this device. Reviewed by you or an educator, not AI graded.

validators.text: Add enough reasoning to review (at least 30 characters).

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l15.rubric
elements.html:
Self-check

  • Tests actual claims and accessibility.
  • Shows a revision tied to evidence.
  • States remaining uncertainty honestly.
  • Justifies final decision, including non-use.
  • Explains independent learning without overstating skill.

Peer feedback is optional and must be real if reported. Self-testing is acceptable; do not invent participants or claim certification.
